title: Routes in scope, and how FDA route terms map to them
notes: In-scope categories are the owner's decisions of 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-11 (SYS-109). The owner checked this mapping on 2026-11-12 (OD-042). Feeding tube is not a category: the FDA directory lists almost no ENTERAL products and suitability for a feeding tube is the clinician's judgement (OD-045). Any FDA route not listed here, for example BUCCAL, TRANSDERMAL, ENTERAL or any injection, is treated as outside scope. Biologic product types (cold_chain_product_types) are treated as cold chain, and so outside scope, whatever the lot says (owner, 2026-11-12; OD-049). Compressed gases (any dosage form beginning with an excluded form, here GAS) are outside scope (owner, 2026-11-12; OD-051, REV-002). A product without a product type is outside scope, because a biologic could not be recognised (owner, 2026-11-12; REV-001).
